They are used to help you remove stubborn stains and brighten fabrics so that they can look almost as good as new. Bleaches convert the stains and soils into colourless, soluble particles that can be removed with the help of detergents, and washed away with water. Liquid chlorine bleach can be used to disinfect and deodorise fabrics for hygienic use.
